page.overview:
Who is Anneloes van de Maarel?

Sister Anneloes van de Maarel is the common people's voice on the Directorate, and she works hard to see that they are not forgotten in its work. When a new tax is ordered, for example, she arranges that some of the money goes to support the cult's work among the sick and poor. Through her efforts the Stadsraad has agreed to pay for the establishment of a few soup kitchens in the city's poorest districts, even though her colleagues in the council think it no better than tossing money over the wall into the fens.
